title: Bounded neighbor influential vertex fraction
statement: Let $q$ be a positive integer and let $G$ be a regular unique game over $q$ symbols. Let the table assign to each vertex a function from the Boolean cube $\\{−1,1\\}^{q}$ to $[-1,1]$, and let $\\varepsilon$ be real. The bounded neighbor influential vertex fraction is the expectation over vertices of the indicator that the vertex has at least one bounded neighbor influential coordinate.
hypotheses_covered: A regular unique game with alphabet size $q$

caveat: The vertex averaging distribution and the averaged neighbor function used to determine influential coordinates are not defined in the supplied snippet.
